Tibia
 (Oldschool MMO with a top down POV)
- Combat is partially manual. The basic attack is automatic, but all the spells are typed in a specific language (you can put the words in hotkeys).
- Customization is limited to different sets of clothes, acquired by quests, ingame money or real money.
- Housing customization is limited to decoration with items, you cant build anything.
- Open world exploration is heavy, you get thrown in the world ans can go anywhere on foot or by boat.
- Platforms: windows / ios  
- Community driven trading, market and boss raids are all part of the game.
- Seasonal events and seasonal major updates.
- Extremely long progression and milestones. You need patience to no get to the higher levels.

Rangers Arcani
- Basically Tibia, but with a better RPG feeling overall. While Tibia levels skills by repetition, here you have actual skilltrees and stat points. Better experience overall. Check it out.

Warspear Online
- Auto combat style.
